points: The character who holds the answer, in a giant close-up, does the thing the hook asks about and reveals the opposite of what people assume; the hook question.
'Picture this': the viewer is dropped into the place, seen wide from afar, arriving.
The viewer's stand-in lands in the place and feels the first condition (the heat and glare).
The others react to the threat and flee to the dark place: the problem is set up.
The hero follows them into the dark place.
The problem lands: in the dark the hero cannot see anything.
The mechanism starts: the body part involved in its first state, on a full-frame glow.
The mechanism with its real number: the state changes and a clock counts to the number while the part adapts.
The consequence of the problem starts: unseen others sneak up in the dark.
Slapstick consequence: the hero gets hit by something he cannot see.
The turn: the insider arrives and does the one simple trick.
Why the trick works, shown from the insider's point of view: his prepared side sees the dark place clearly.
The payoff of the trick: everything hidden is now visible to him, the others are caught.
Proof: a real test of the idea, shown as a checklist ticked and stamped with the verdict.
Payoff line that flips the hook: the one everyone pitied was the only one who could do it.

scenes.picture: Extreme close-up of a stick person (head and chest fill the frame, figure drawn about 1500 px tall with feet below the frame): yellow bean torso, big white round head with a purple polka-dot bandana and a black eye patch, one eye open, smirk. Behind him a blurred (5 px) sunny deck: sky, tall cliff pillars with green tops, sea band, red railing, barrel and cannon, a second small figure far back. Slow push-in (+3.5%) with handheld drift; at 2.5 s his hand reaches up (IK) and lifts the patch with a backOut pop, revealing a healthy eye with a white 4-point sparkle; mouth turns to a grin. Captions 1-2 words at y 1345.

Wide establishing view: bright sky gradient (blue top to warm cream at the horizon), large sun with additive glow and slowly turning rays, clouds, tall cliff pillars with green blob tops on the horizon, a turquoise sea band with drifting white wave dashes to the bottom; two sailing ships bob on the water; a tiny stick person swings on a rope from one ship to the other. Camera pans right and pushes in (+6%) with a warm heat glow over the frame. Whip in and whip out.

Sunny ship deck: sky with sun, cliff pillars, red railing (bulwark) across the frame at about y 900, wooden deck floor in perspective (planks from a vanishing point above, lighter toward the viewer), a mast, rigging, barrels and a crate. The red-striped stick person (red polka-dot bandana) swings in on a rope, lands with squash and two dust puffs, then squints at the sun with gritted teeth, shading his eyes, sweat drops; a warm screen-blend heat glow pulses. Camera follows and pushes in from 1.0 to 1.22.

Wide deck view (horizon higher): a hatch hole in the floor in perspective with a ladder top; three blue-striped crew stick people in white sailor caps idle, then panic (wide eyes, gritted teeth, raised brows, yellow '!' marks, sweat drops), run with hands up and jump down the hatch one after another (clipped at the hatch edge). The hero enters from the left edge grinning with a sword in his raised hand. Slow push-in 1.0 to 1.1, handheld drift. Hard cut out.

Same deck and hatch, closer (zoom 1.15 to 1.35, camera tilting down toward the hatch): the hero runs in from the right with a determined grin, jumps (hands up, mouth O) and drops into the hatch, clipped by its front edge; a dust puff rises from the hole. Hard cut to black.

Near-black frame (L about 0.11): the hero is a black silhouette barely darker than the ground, drawn huge (about 2400 px tall) so only the head shows; only his two white eyes glow, darting left, right, then blinking; a sweat drop. Slow push-in. Whip out.

Diagram shot: a full-frame hot radial glow (cream centre, yellow, orange edge) with 16 slowly rotating white rays at 18%; a big outlined eye (almond shape 720 px wide, white with a teal iris of radial lines, a small black pupil, highlights, 5 lashes) with a squinting lid; above it a sun icon (outlined circle with 10 rotating rays). Zoom settles from 1.12 to 1.0 after the whip in.

scenes.picture: Continuation of the diagram: the glow turns into a dark navy radial gradient with 40 twinkling star dots; the lid opens, the sun icon shrinks away and a gold pocket stopwatch pops in (backOut) whose blue wedge fills as the minute hand sweeps; a big yellow number with a thick ink outline counts up beside it ('NN MIN', pops 25% on landing); the pupil widens slowly to most of the iris with two small yellow arrows pointing outward. Held while the line finishes.

Dark interior (wooden wall boards and ribs at near-black with a blue tint): two crew silhouettes sneak in from both sides holding frying pans; the hero is a silhouette with only white eyes looking left and right. Camera close (zoom 1.45 to 1.62).

First hit: a pan swings (eased arc) onto the hero's head; a yellow jagged burst with a red 'BONK!' word pops (backOut, 0.5 s), the camera shakes (30 px decaying in 0.25 s) and rotates slightly, a warm flash (35%) lights the silhouettes brown for a moment; the hero's eyes become white X marks.
Second hit from the other side: another BONK burst, shake and flash; eyes become rotating spirals and three yellow stars circle the head. Whip out.

Below deck in a warm light shaft (additive trapezoid from the top): the yellow-shirted insider drops in from above (arms up), lands with squash, camera punches in from 1.0 to 1.75 on him; he reaches to the patch and flips it to the other eye with a backOut snap; a white sparkle on the revealed eye, his mouth goes from smirk to grin. Hard cut out.

Black frame; a circular reveal opens from the centre (radial gradient mask, radius 0 to 1500 px over 2.8 s) with a faint light-blue iris ring at its edge, showing the hold in cool blue-grey: three crew members holding pans, barrels, a crate, a lantern; the reveal is an eye opening.

Same hold fully revealed (blue multiply tint fading to warm): the three crew members startle (wide eyes, teeth, hands up, jump 60 px, sweat drops); the hero lies knocked out on the floor with spiral eyes. Whip out.

Top view of a wooden table (horizontal boards); a cream paper card (820 x 1140, rounded, ink outline, drop shadow, tilted -2 degrees) with a two-line serif title, an underline, a doodle head and three checklist rows; green ticks pop in one by one (0.35 s apart, backOut); a big wooden rubber stamp on an ink arm slams down (easeIn), leaving a red rotated stamp word with a double border and ink-speckle holes, dust puffs, camera shake. Whip out.

Lantern-lit hold (warm additive glow): the insider stands on a treasure chest of gold coins holding a lit lantern, grinning, taps the patch and winks with a sparkle; the three crew members sit tied together with a rope, frowning; the hero lies dazed on the floor with stars circling. Opens punched in (1.6) and pulls out to 1.0, then holds.
